mapper.update: UPDATE wms_inbound_order SET sync_status = '同步中', last_sync_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND inbound_status = '已审核' AND deleted_at = 0 AND ( sync_status IN ('待同步', '同步失败') OR (sync_status = '同步中' AND (last_sync_time IS NULL OR last_sync_time < #{staleBefore})) )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wms_inbound_order WHERE deleted_at = 0 AND inbound_status = '已审核' AND ( sync_status IN ('待同步', '同步失败') OR (sync_status = '同步中' AND (last_sync_time IS NULL OR last_sync_time < #{staleBefore})) ) ORDER BY last_sync_time IS NULL DESC, last_sync_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
